name: VideoGo-Bench
description:
Dataset README
	


	
		
		Overview
	

This dataset contains Go game sequences for training and evaluation purposes. The data is organized in WebDataset format for efficient training, along with additional files for model evaluation.

	
		
		Dataset Structure
	


	
		
		1. Training Data (00000{idx}.tar)
	


WebDataset-format tar files containing Go game image sequences  
Each 00000{idx}.tar contains multiple game sequences


	
		
		2. Evaluation Data
